answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen price, while the mandated 18% spend reduction makes renewal unlikely to meet the cost objective. Memory_c2 supports a potentially fast, lower-cost transition with accurate invoicing, but it does not establish delivery performance under a 94%-loaded assembly schedule. Verify that record before committing, and limit the switch to a guarded initial scope with explicit delivery/service-level protections rather than assuming its historical cost result transfers without risk.
